items.fact: PC Gamer's mission list says the game has five chapters and 91 story missions, with the final mission name hidden to avoid spoilers.
Push Square and Insider Gaming count 93 main story missions across five chapters. That differs from PC Gamer's 91, probably because of how optional missions are counted.

The chapters are Just Like Paradise (Leonida Keys), Paradise Lost (Port Gellhorn), Tits, Ass, Drug Money (Vice City), Vice City, Baby, and Top of the World, Ma. Chapter 5 is the shortest, with 7 missions.
The story follows Jason and Lucia. The Prologue starts with Lucia in prison and Jason free on the outside, and it includes a flashback to the robbery that got her arrested.
Early supporting characters include Brian, Cal, Donnie, Mandy and Mattia. Lucia is released from Hamlet Correctional in the Coming Home mission.
Leonida has six main regions: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.
Port Gellhorn is a run-down former tourist area with cheap motels and abandoned malls. Ambrosia is the industrial heart of the state, with the Allied Crystal Sugar refinery and biker gangs.
There are 18 collectible card sets. Set sizes run from 12 cards (Backyard Wrestling) to 36 (for example Jack of Hearts and Nine1Nine), and the Vice City Club de Futbol set has 30.
You need 15 of the 18 card sets for 100% completion, and the Don't Touch My Deck trophy only needs 3 complete sets.

There are 27 magazines, books and comics to find, though 100% completion requires 30 magazines, books and comics. Push Square's WAiNK trophy section lists 31 landmark, 35 curiosity and 23 sculpture locations.
Cards range from nearly worthless to valuable. One rare card found near Key Lento reportedly sells for about $6,000, so cards are a decent way to earn cash.
The 100% completion checklist requires fencing $100,000 of jewelry and $250,000 of marked bills, which shows that robberies are a core income source.
Besides the story, each chapter lets you explore the open world, earn money from robberies, and play activities such as racing and miniature golf.
Strangers & Freaks side missions include Shirley's errands (Chapter 1 only) and Kirk's skunk ape hunt. There are also robbery jobs and Randy's wish list of collectibles.
The Slim Jim, unlocked in the Chapter 2 Moses mission, lets you break into cars silently. The Key Cloner arrives in Chapter 3's Steal the Zorrusso for Randy.
Completed missions can't be replayed, so finish side content before you move on if you want to be thorough.
Each character can carry two duffel bags during robberies. Bag capacity depends on the size of the building you rob.

The Pry Bar unlocks in Chapter 3 and equips automatically near wooden crates, which often hold ammo, weapons or collectibles. The Snap Gun, from the jewelry fence Yasmani, opens locked doors without triggering alarms.
Many PS5 players report repeated crashes with error CE-108255-1 after early story moments, and no game update had been released to fix it yet.
One reported trigger for the PS5 crash is using the plunger in the Pipework mission. Clearing the cache, rebuilding the database and reinstalling the game didn't fix it for affected players.
A glitch on Xbox Series X (game version 01.002.001, with a 120Hz monitor) can uncap the 30 FPS limit. It may be patched out.
The game has no dedicated first-person mode at launch. A glitch forces first person, and you must reload your save to get back to third person.
